physical.title: Surround for Turkish Silk Cushion Cover
physical.medium_raw: Silk, silver-metal thread: plain weave with inner warps and with continuous and discontinuous supplementary wefts bound in plain and 1/3 Z twill order
physical.summary: Surround for Turkish Silk Cushion Cover, early 1600s. Iran, Safavid period (1501–1722). Silk, silver-metal thread: plain weave with inner warps and with continuous and discontinuous supplementary wefts bound in plain and 1/3 Z twill order; overall: 109 x 23.3 cm (42 15/16 x 9 3/16 in.). The Cleveland Museum of Art, Andrew R. and Martha Holden Jennings Fund, 2007.13.5
